basics.name: Robin Winters
basics.label: iOS Engineer | Applied AI Systems
basics.summary: Robin Winters builds native iOS software and applied AI systems, with a focus on fitness technology. Interested in iOS developer, Forward Deployed Engineer and fitness-technology roles.

work.name: ShowFlex Inc
highlights: Architected and developed a design-forward consumer iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
Built a MapKit-based event discovery feature with advanced search and filtering capabilities.
Created ingestion pipelines to normalize global event calendars and athlete metadata into structured data.
Led cross-functional collaboration with engineering, product design, and external partners to ensure seamless delivery.
work.summary: Prototype work: AI-assisted physique and posing feedback; Predictive competition features.

work.name: Yukon Systems
highlights: Led technical prioritization and cross-functional delivery for AI-driven systems in high-reliability environments.
Translated research concepts into actionable software requirements and execution plans for iOS devices.
Collaborated with engineers on architecture decisions focusing on reliability, explainability, and performance.

work.name: Organic Alkaloids
highlights: Developed and maintained operational workflows for iOS devices to streamline overseas sourcing and vendor coordination.
Managed logistics and shipment planning to enhance customer delivery processes.
Fostered strong client relationships through effective communication and marketing strategies.

projects.name: Xclawd Duo — early iPhone Duo interface preview
projects.description: Robin Winters’s early preview of an AI-enabled IDE for iPhone Duo, with a folding coding workspace, tabletop keyboard, and Aqua and Windows NT-inspired themes.
highlights: Early development build; folding layouts, tabletop keyboard and Aqua/Windows NT-inspired themes.
Full-length 57.15-second simulator preview; no App Store release, successful AI generation or measured performance claim.
Original LinkedIn post: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7513816884191043584/

projects.name: ShowFlex iPhone product
projects.description: Native iOS engineering at ShowFlex. Public iPhone listing verified October 2, 2026; publisher and seller ShowFlex Inc.
highlights: Swift/SwiftUI, MapKit event discovery, Firebase-backed data and ingestion pipelines.
AI-assisted physique/posing feedback and predictive competition features are prototypes, not established released product capabilities.
No sole authorship, Android release or measured adoption/performance claim.

projects.name: TORos — Yukon Systems prototype
projects.description: Robin Winters built TORos for Yukon Systems: a prototype, model-agnostic, multimodal decision engine that uses deliberation among multiple models to reach consensus.
highlights: Prototype status; no production deployment or measured accuracy/reliability claim. Development dates and collaborator credits are not yet documented.
Yukon Systems publicly described TOROS on May 5, 2025: https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/part-one-orchestration-alignment-through-agentic-consensus-lh2tf/
Contribution confirmed by Robin; company publication does not identify individual builders. No sole authorship claim.

projects.name: Swift search request ownership example
projects.description: Standalone educational example prepared with coding-assistant support, separate from private product source.
highlights: Seven Swift Testing checks passed on macOS with Swift 6.4.
No iPhone runtime or SwiftUI adapter validation claimed.
